findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Numerous dead bugs are observed around the inside rim of the display chest freezer in front of the register. The PIC is instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mop is observed being stored in dirty mop water in the bathroom. The PIC was notified and instructed to stored so that it can drip dry when not in use. Ensure proper storage moving forward.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

Paper towels were not available at the hand sink in the bathroom. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tight fitting and self-closing door. 

The restroom door does not have a correctly functioning self closer. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Damp mop observed in a pile in the restroom. Store wet mops so that they can air dry without soiling their surroundings. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 6-501.16     [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Restroom door is neither self-closing nor tight-fitting. There is a significant gap between the bottom of the door and the floor. Repair so door is self-closing and tight-fitting. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 6-501.19     [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT: Frost build up observed in the ice cream freezer. Clean routinely to prevent accumulation. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 4-602.13     [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
No triple sink present for washing food contact equipment (like an ice scoop). Cease handling ice without appropriate equipment for sanitizing. CORRECTED.
Ref. 4-501.114     [P/Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels available in the restroom. Disposable paper towels must be provided. CORRECTED.
Ref. 6-301.12     [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
The only handwashing sink is located in the restroom. If any level of food handling (other than prepackaged foods) is going to occur, an additional (not in the restroom) handsink would be required. Cease handling ice without appropriate handwashing facilities. CORRECTED. 
Ref. 2-301.15     [Pf]

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed brownies with no label. PIC stated someone gave brownies to store. No TCS foods from unapproved source can be sold to customers. Corrected. PIC discarded brownies and stated he would no longer sell unapproved products. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed Styrofoam used as bottom rack for Reach-in Freezer. All non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth, durable and easily cleanable. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed frost build up in chest freezer and reach-in freezer. 
Observed reach-in coolers to be soiled with debris on racks. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
